[!cgo] skip 'cgo is not available'

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env CGO_ENABLED=1
env GOEXPERIMENT=nologosfastcgo

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^sum: 42$'
stdout '^separate: 23$'
stdout '^pointer: 42$'
stdout '^errno: -1 true$'
stdout '^nilable: true$'
stdout '^bridge: 42$'
stdout '^return: logos: nil from Go value stored into non-nil .* at cbridge\.lgo:[0-9]+$'
stdout '^local: logos: nil from Go value stored into non-nil .* at cbridge\.lgo:[0-9]+$'
stdout '^argument: logos: nil from Go value stored into non-nil .* at cbridge\.lgo:[0-9]+$'
stdout '^field: logos: nil from Go value stored into non-nil .* at cbridge\.lgo:[0-9]+$'
stdout '^literal: logos: nil from Go value stored into non-nil .* at cbridge\.lgo:[0-9]+$'
stdout '^slice: logos: nil from Go value stored into non-nil .* at cbridge\.lgo:[0-9]+$'
stdout '^callback: runtime: function marked with #cgo nocallback called back into Go$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt
cp cbridge.lgo $WORK/original-cbridge.lgo
cp second.lgo $WORK/original-second.lgo

# Ejection must replay checked-source semantics onto the original C
# source. Cgo's rewritten calls may contain pointer-check closures.
logos eject -o ../out
exists ../out/cbridge.go
exists ../out/second.go
exists ../out/bridge/bridge.go
grep '#cgo noescape invoke' ../out/cbridge.go
grep '#cgo nocallback invoke' ../out/cbridge.go
! grep '_Cfunc_|_cgoCheckPointer|\.cgo1\.go' ../out/cbridge.go
cmp cbridge.lgo $WORK/original-cbridge.lgo
cmp second.lgo $WORK/original-second.lgo

cd ../out
env GOEXPERIMENT=
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
exists $UPROOT1273/bin/go
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1273/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1273/bin/go vet ./...
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .

# The source contract does not depend on selecting the fast trampoline.
cd ../m
env GOEXPERIMENT=logosfastcgo
logos run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
logos eject -o ../out-fast
cmp ../out/cbridge.go ../out-fast/cbridge.go
cmp ../out/second.go ../out-fast/second.go
cmp ../out/bridge/bridge.go ../out-fast/bridge/bridge.go

# The frontend-only mode must require an eject destination. It must not
# silently turn an ordinary compiler invocation into a successful build.
! go tool compile -logos.cgoeject ../invalid.lgo
stdout 'logos.cgoeject requires logos.eject'

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/directcgo

go 1.27

-- m/logos.toml --
[build]
cgo = "allow"

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"strconv"

	"example.com/directcgo/bridge"
)

func parsed() (int, error) {
	n := strconv.Atoi("19")?
	return n + Separate(), nil
}

func caught(f func()) (message string) {
	defer func() {
		if p := recover(); p != nil {
			message = fmt.Sprint(p)
		}
	}()
	f()
	return "no panic"
}

func main() {
	n, err := parsed()
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Println("sum:", n)
	fmt.Println("separate:", Separate())
	fmt.Println("pointer:", PointerArg())
	v, errno := Errno()
	fmt.Println("errno:", v, errno)
	fmt.Println("nilable:", Nilable())
	fmt.Println("bridge:", bridge.Answer())
	fmt.Println("return:", caught(ReturnNil))
	fmt.Println("local:", caught(LocalNil))
	fmt.Println("argument:", caught(ArgumentNil))
	fmt.Println("field:", caught(FieldNil))
	fmt.Println("literal:", caught(LiteralNil))
	fmt.Println("slice:", caught(SliceNil))
	fmt.Println("callback:", caught(Callback))
}

-- m/cbridge.lgo --
package main

/*
#include <errno.h>
#include <stddef.h>

struct item { int value; struct item *next; };
static struct item present = {42, 0};
static struct item *missing(void) { return NULL; }
static struct item *found(void) { return &present; }
static int *pointer_arg(void **p) { return &present.value; }
static int failure(void) { errno = EINVAL; return -1; }

extern int callback(int);
//logos:cgo_fastcall invoke
static int invoke(void) { return callback(41); }
*/
import "C"

import "unsafe"

type holder struct { p *C.struct_item }

func item() *C.struct_item { return C.missing() }
func ReturnNil() { _ = item() }

func LocalNil() {
	var p *C.struct_item = C.missing()
	_ = p
}

func take(p *C.struct_item) { _ = p }
func ArgumentNil() { take(C.missing()) }

func FieldNil() {
	h := holder{p: C.found()}
	h.p = C.missing()
}

func LiteralNil() { _ = holder{p: C.missing()} }

func SliceNil() {
	x := []*C.struct_item{C.found()}
	x[0] = C.missing()
}

func pointer() *C.int {
	var p unsafe.Pointer
	return C.pointer_arg(&p)
}

func PointerArg() int { return int(*pointer()) }

func Errno() (int, bool) {
	v, err := C.failure()
	return int(v), err != nil
}

func Nilable() bool {
	var value C.struct_item
	return value.next == nil && C.missing() == nil
}

//export callback
func callback(v C.int) C.int { return v + 1 }

func Callback() { C.invoke() }

-- m/second.lgo --
package main

// #define LOCAL_VALUE 23
// static int local(void) { return LOCAL_VALUE; }
import "C"

func Separate() int { return int(C.local()) }

-- m/bridge/bridge.lgo --
package bridge

/*
#define LOCAL_VALUE 42
static int local(void) { return LOCAL_VALUE; }
*/
import "C"

func Answer() int { return int(C.local()) }

-- invalid.lgo --
package main

func broken() { undefined() }
